boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Free, under-21-safe arts outings documented by Grove City College as requiring no admission or purchase. Confirm the next scheduled edition before visiting.

cards.title: Catch an Orchesis Dance Show
cards.subtitle: Student dance in the Physical Learning Center Arena
cards.notes: Bring friends to a scheduled Orchesis performance, and use the official Family Weekend page to confirm the next showtime.
cards.short_summary: A student-led dance program spanning multiple styles and staged as a free public performance.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College stated that its 2026 Family Weekend concerts and performances were free and open to the public and specifically identified Orchesis as free and public.
cards.access_notes: The documented 2026 performances occurred April 23–25 in the Physical Learning Center Arena; confirm the next scheduled edition before going.

cards.title: Hear the College Bands Together
cards.subtitle: Symphonic Concert Band and Wind Ensemble in Ketler Auditorium
cards.notes: Meet at Pew Fine Arts Center for the paired band program, checking the College music calendar before choosing a date.
cards.short_summary: Two Grove City ensembles share one public concert program featuring wind-band repertoire.
cards.evidence_claim: The College included the 2026 “Joy in All Things” Symphonic Concert Band and Wind Ensemble concert among Family Weekend concerts and performances that were free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The documented concert was held April 24, 2026, in Ketler Auditorium; consult the current music calendar for a future performance.

cards.title: Browse the Student Art Exhibit
cards.subtitle: Rotating artwork inside Pew Fine Arts Center
cards.notes: Walk the gallery with a friend and compare favorite pieces; check the exhibit notice first because displays and hours rotate.
cards.short_summary: A quiet gallery hang centered on work by Grove City students and visiting artists.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College identifies the Pew Fine Arts Center Gallery as a venue for rotating exhibitions, and its official gallery coverage states that the gallery is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: ‘Meet the Fleet’ brings HopeCAT artists to campus
cards.access_notes: Public gallery access is free; exhibition dates and opening hours vary, so verify the current listing before visiting.

cards.title: Watch a Set of One-Act Plays
cards.subtitle: Short student productions in the Little Theatre
cards.notes: Choose one of the listed performances and arrive together at the Little Theatre; verify the next festival schedule first.
cards.short_summary: A compact theater outing featuring several student-produced short plays in one program.
cards.evidence_claim: The College listed Alpha Psi Omega’s 2026 One-Act show among Family Weekend concerts and performances that were free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The documented performances occurred April 24–25, 2026, in the Little Theatre; confirm future dates through the College calendar.

cards.entity_name: Jazz Ensemble and Stage Band Concert
cards.title: Settle In for Student Jazz
cards.subtitle: Jazz Ensemble and Stage Band in Ketler Auditorium
cards.notes: Gather a group for the full ensemble-and-combo program, then check the official listing for the next public concert date.
cards.short_summary: A live jazz hang pairing the College’s larger ensemble with its seven-piece Stage Band.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College included the 2026 Jazz Ensemble and Stage Band concert among Family Weekend concerts and performances that were free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The documented concert occurred April 25, 2026, in Ketler Auditorium; verify the next concert on the College music calendar.

cards.title: Cheer Through All-College Sing
cards.subtitle: Campus groups perform in a friendly song-and-dance competition
cards.notes: Go with classmates to support the performing groups, and consult the Family Weekend schedule for the next event time.
cards.short_summary: A school-specific showcase where campus organizations combine singing, movement, and friendly competition.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College listed the 2026 All-College Sing among Family Weekend concerts and performances that were free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The documented event occurred April 25, 2026, in the Physical Learning Center Arena; verify the next Family Weekend schedule.

cards.title: Listen to the Revelation Ringers
cards.subtitle: Grove City student handbell choir at Tower Presbyterian Church
cards.notes: Walk into town with friends for the handbell program, checking the College listing for the choir’s next public appearance.
cards.short_summary: A student handbell performance offering a different sound from the College’s band and choir concerts.
cards.evidence_claim: The College identified the Revelation Ringers concert as part of its 2026 Family Weekend slate of concerts and performances that were free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The documented concert occurred April 26, 2026, at Tower Presbyterian Church; confirm the next public performance before going.

cards.title: Hear Two Choirs Perform Haydn
cards.subtitle: Concert Choir and Touring Choir in Harbison Chapel
cards.notes: Meet at Harbison Chapel for the combined-choir program, and verify the next concert date through the music calendar.
cards.short_summary: A large choral outing combining two College choirs with organ accompaniment in the campus chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College included the combined Concert Choir and Touring Choir performance of Haydn’s “Creation” in its 2026 Family Weekend slate, whose concerts and performances were free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: The documented performance occurred April 26, 2026, in Harbison Chapel; consult the current calendar for another public concert.

cards.entity_name: Symphony and Chamber Orchestras Spring Concert
cards.title: Share an Orchestra Night
cards.subtitle: Two College orchestras in Ketler Auditorium
cards.notes: Claim seats together for the paired orchestra program, using the official music notice to confirm the next performance.
cards.short_summary: A full evening of orchestral music featuring both Grove City’s Symphony and Chamber Orchestras.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College stated that the March 27, 2026, Symphony and Chamber Orchestras concert was free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Concert features Symphony and Chamber orchestras
cards.access_notes: The documented concert occurred March 27, 2026, in Ketler Auditorium; verify the orchestras’ next public concert date.

cards.title: Welcome the Touring Choir Home
cards.subtitle: Tour repertoire performed in Harbison Chapel
cards.notes: Bring a friend to hear the choir’s road program at home, checking the official calendar for its next chapel concert.
cards.short_summary: A home-campus choral performance presenting repertoire prepared for the Touring Choir’s regional trip.
cards.evidence_claim: Grove City College stated that the Touring Choir’s March 14, 2026, home concert in Harbison Chapel was free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Touring Choir brings its road songs home to Harbison
cards.access_notes: The documented concert occurred March 14, 2026, in Harbison Chapel; check the current music calendar for the next edition.

warnings: The directly documented 2026 performances have already occurred as of the fetch date. Each card therefore directs readers to confirm the next scheduled edition rather than implying current availability.
Current official sources did not provide a full future 2026–27 free-event calendar, so this board uses recently documented recurring-style campus arts outings and clearly identifies expired dates.
